traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Griseliniaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; stipules absent; plants dioecious; ovary inferior; floral cup present; stems woody; flowers in racemes or in panicles; flowers actinomorphic; perianth usually sepals and petals, sometimes tepals; fruit berry; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 5; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
